thread:
alex: Heads-up: ops wants to run a conservative admin-prune canary next week as part of the quarterly least-priv review. Need ops + infra + legal signoff on evidence format.
tim: +1. Can we do a sampled run first (10% of projects) to validate rollbacks? We shouldn't blast everything at once.
nina: Sampling sounds good. Also we should add KMS/key material safeguards. If we remove a role and a service account loses KMS access, that can surface as silent failures.
maria: Agreed. Proposal: two-phase approach. 1) dry-run scan + artifact collection, 2) sampled canary (5-10 projects) with infra guard enabled, 3) full sweep. Each step produces immutable evidence stored for auditors.
alex: Dry-run commands?
nina: Example exports I'll run: ```bash
# GCP key IAM snapshot
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/$PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/$KR/cryptoKeys/$KEY --format=json > $KEY-iam.json
sha256sum $KEY-iam.json > $KEY-iam.sha256
# AWS key policy snapshot
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id $KEY_ID --policy-name default > $KEY-aws-policy.json
sha256sum $KEY-aws-policy.json > $KEY-aws-policy.sha256
# bucket/object ACLs
aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket my-bucket > bucket-acl.json
```
tim: Add `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJ --flatten=bindings` output too so we can see bindings at project level. Also log which principals reference `roles/editor` / `roles/owner`.
infra-ci: CI note: I'll implement a runtime guard flag `--fail-if-role-missing` in infra-agent and ship it to staging. When enabled, deploys that reference a removed role will fail with a clear error and link to remediation docs.
alex: Good. Legal: what's the required artifact?
legal: We need an immutable package per principal that contains: binding snapshot (json), KMS/key policy snapshot, bucket ACLs, notification history (emails/slack), ticket reference, and a checksum manifest with signed hash. Prefer GPG-signed tar.gz stored in the compliance bucket.
maria: Can we automate manifest creation?
nina: Yes. I can run a script that collects files and creates a manifest and signs it. Sample: ```bash
tar czf evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz $PRINCIPAL-*.json $PRINCIPAL-*.log
sha256sum evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz > evidence-$PRINCIPAL.sha256
gpg --output evidence-$PRINCIPAL.sig --detach-sign evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz
mc cp evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz s3://compliance-archive/$RUN_ID/
mc cp evidence-$PRINCIPAL.sha256 s3://compliance-archive/$RUN_ID/
mc cp evidence-$PRINCIPAL.sig s3://compliance-archive/$RUN_ID/
```
tim: Recovery plan: if a canary breaks a service, we should have a fast path to re-add a time-limited binding and trigger an automated rollback. Implement `rebind-temp --principal X --ttl 1h` that both re-adds and records the event in audit.
infra-ci: CI will include an automated smoke test post-prune. If smoke fails, CI triggers `rebind-temp` and opens a P0 ticket with logs.
sec-bot: IncidentBot: Created task TASK-4909 "quarterly least-priv sampled prune planning" assigned to alex, nina.
alex: Timeline: dry-run Mon, sampled canary Wed 03:00 UTC, full sweep after signoff next week.
maria: Action owners: nina will produce snapshot scripts + evidence signer, infra-ci will flip guard in staging and run smoke tests, tim will own rollback tooling, legal will confirm artifact retention period.
legal: Retention requested: 7 years for compliance artifacts. Confirming storage class/ACLs.
alex: We'll keep prune window small (5-15m per project) and run with enhanced tracing. Ops will collect traces to /var/log/priv-prune/$RUN_ID.
maria: Please link PRs & tickets in this thread. Also include exact commands in the runbook so auditors can replay.
nina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security-scripts/pull/77. Scripts include GCP & AWS snapshots, manifest generator, and upload step.
infra-ci: Guard branch created; staging run scheduled Tue 18:00 UTC.
tim: I've sketched `rebind-temp` in tools repo and will add automated tests. PR soon.
alex: Thanks all. Let's treat this as high priority but cautious. Post results here after the sampled canary. :eyes:
